spans.s: अद्वय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Not two; 2. without a second, unique.
अद्वय (II) n. 1. Non-duality, unity; 2. identity of spirit and matter.
अद्वय (III) m. A follower of Buddha.
अद्वय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Not two; 2. without a second, unique.
अद्वय-वादिन् m. 1. one who teaches advaya or identity; 2. a Bauddha.
अद्वार n. Any passage which is not intended to be used as a door, अद्वारेण न चातीयाद्ग्रामं वा वेश्म वा वृतम् M.iv.73.
अद्वितीय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Without a second, i.e. matchless; 2. without a companion, i.e. alone.
अद्वितीय (I) a. (f. या) 1. Without a second, i.e. matchless; 2. without a companion, i.e. alone.
अद्वैत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Destitute of duality; 2. peerless, unique.
अद्वैत (II) n. 1. Identity, sameness, अद्वैतं सुखदुःखयोः Ut.i.; 2. the Vedāntic doctrine of the identity of Brahman (n.) with the universe or with the soul; 3. Brahman (n.).
अद्वैत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Destitute of duality; 2. peerless, unique.
अद्वैत-वादिन् m. one who maintains the identity of Brahman (n.) with the universe, a Vedāntist.
